title: feat(mcp): aggregate_records returns select groups in declared option order and names a fixed amount's currency
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8AJJJRiYjshMUNgyMZSqBsr)_

Refs #35138 (items select order, currency)
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:MCP 的 `aggregate_records` 工具在调用方未指定排序时,按 select/radio 字段声明的选项顺序返回分组(未声明的值排最后),排序发生在 50 行截断之前;对 `sum`/`avg`/`min`/`max` 这类金额列,若字段是固定币种(`currencyConfig.currencyMode: 'fixed'`),结果多出 `currencies` 成员,按列别名给出 ISO 4217 币种代码。HTTP 和 stdio 两个入口走同一个处理函数。
- 为什么改:#35138 第二个 PR(W0 决定表的「select 选项顺序」「金额币种」两行):托管问数工具发现模型照搬工具返回的东西,分组顺序乱、金额不带币种时答案会错;这两项从托管层挪进框架,开源 MCP 客户端也能拿到。
- 风险与回滚:只读调用方能看到的对象定义(`servedObjectDefinitionOf`),看不到的字段不排序也不报币种;读不到定义时返回与之前完全相同。已有成员 `rows`/`totalGroups`/`truncated` 不变,`currencies` 只在有固定币种金额时出现。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:① `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts` 的 `inDeclaredOptionOrder`:多个分组键时只按前导的 select 键排序,遇到第一个非 select 键即停;② 同文件 `aggregate_records` 处理函数里排序在截断之前;③ `fixedAmountCurrencies` 只认 `fixed` 模式。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/mcp-http-tools.aggregation-entry.test.ts`,预期 19 个测试全绿,其中 10 个是本 PR 新增的 #35138 用例。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`aggregate_records` (`packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts`, one handler serving both the HTTP and the stdio door) now reads two facts off the object as the caller is served it, through the existing optional bridge member `servedObjectDefinitionOf` (both bridges implement it, each answering the caller-masked definition):

- **Select option order.** When the call sends no ordering, groups keyed by a `select` or `radio` field come back in the order the field declares its options. A value no option declares, such as a null, sorts last. The group keys are read in `groupBy` order while each is such a field: the first key that is not one ends the reading, and the groups under it keep the driver's order. The sort is stable and runs over every group before the tool's cap, so the cap keeps the first declared groups. A group key's `alias` is honoured. `multiselect` is not ordered, because its group value is a combination.
- **Currency.** A new present-only result member `currencies` maps an amount column's alias to its ISO 4217 code, when the column is `sum`/`avg`/`min`/`max` over a field whose `currencyConfig` is `currencyMode: 'fixed'`. `count` and `count_distinct` carry none.
- The tool description gains two sentences saying both, plus that a record-currency amount is answered only grouped by its currency code field.

The bridge read is skipped when the call has no group key and no amount column. If the bridge does not have the member, finds no object or throws, the tool answers exactly as before, and the aggregate itself is never failed by it. A field the caller's served schema does not show is never ordered or named.

`currencies` is typed locally in `packages/mcp`. The `aggregate_records` result has no type in `packages/spec`: `git grep aggregate_records -- packages/spec/src` finds two comments in `data/query.zod.ts` about the input entry, and no result schema. No guidance text enters the spec (ADR-0149 M1).

**Record mode, re-measured and unchanged:** the engine already refuses `sum`/`avg`/`min`/`max` over a `record`-mode amount unless it is grouped by the amount's code field (`packages/objectql/src/record-currency-aggregate-door.ts`, ADR-0144 D6), so each group's code is in its row. `packages/objectql/src/record-currency-guards.test.ts` -t "raw aggregate over a record-mode amount" on this branch reads `Tests 4 passed | 70 skipped (74)`: ungrouped is refused `INVALID_FIELD`, grouped by another field is refused, and grouped by the code it answers `{ USD: 100, EUR: 100 }`.

## Tests

<details><summary>New pins: top-level describe in packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.aggregation-entry.test.ts (the shared aggregate_records harness)</summary>

- groups of a select field come back in the declared option order, with a value no option declares last
- order read by the group key's alias, and a second select key orders within the first
- order taken before the cap: 60 groups in reverse order come back as `o00`..`o49`, `truncated: true`, `totalGroups: 60`
- CONTROL: a non-select leading key keeps the driver's order, and so do the keys after it
- CONTROL: a select field the served schema does not show is not ordered
- a fixed-currency `sum` and `avg` name `{ total: 'USD', mean: 'USD' }`
- CONTROL: `count`, `count_distinct` over the fixed amount, a non-currency `number` measure, and a `record`-mode and a `dynamic`-mode amount carry no `currencies`
- CONTROL: a fixed-currency field the served schema does not show names no currency
- CONTROL: a bridge without the member, or one that throws, answers byte-for-byte as before
- a call with no group key and no amount column does not read the served schema

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (one per pin, through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs; each restored to the HEAD blob)</summary>

Each mutation landed (anchor count 1 then 0) and the test file went red. Every restore was confirmed by blob `0ed787fe6949` against HEAD:

- A: `const groups = rows;` in place of the option-order call. Red: 3 failed, 16 passed (the three order pins).
- B: the currency assignment replaced by `void defaultCurrency;`. Red: 1 failed (the fixed-currency pin).
- C: the amount-function gate deleted. Red: 1 failed (the CONTROL for count, non-currency, record and dynamic).
- D: `if (!rank) break;` changed to `continue`. Red: 1 failed (the CONTROL for a non-select leading key).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Explicit order overrides option order (CONTROL): NOT MEASURED, reason:** `origin/main` has no ordering argument on `aggregate_records`. Without one, `strictToolInput` refuses an `orderBy` key as unknown. #35144 adds `orderBy`/`limit` on its branch (`claude/issue-35144-aggregate-order-cut`, no PR yet). That path returns before the default path, so option order never reaches an explicit order. The control pin is owed when the second of the two PRs merges `main`. `git merge-tree` of this head with that branch conflicts in one place, the `rows:` line of the default path's result; the resolution keeps `groups` and adds `groupCount`. On that branch, a call with `limit` but no `orderBy` takes the database path with an empty order, so option order does not apply there.
- `currencies` is added on the default path only. #35144's order-and-cut path builds its own result, so whoever merges second should add `currencies` there as well.
- `dynamic` mode carries no currency. The served schema does not hold the tenant's `localization.currency`, so this PR does not invent a value.
- The option sort runs in the application over the list the driver already returned in full (the existing default path loads every group, then caps). It runs no second query, so this is not a slower path built only for parity (Prime Directive 5).

## Verification

All readings below are at head `4582c20e07`, the final commit.

<details><summary>Local subset</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp typecheck`, then `vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over the whole package, run under the shared verify lock. Lock line: `VERDICT command-exit 0`. Result: `Test Files 71 passed (71)`, `Tests 1280 passed (1280)`. The typecheck ran `tsc --noEmit` and `check:test-typecheck`.
- `src/mcp-http-tools.aggregation-entry.test.ts`: `Tests 19 passed (19)`.
- Re-measured the record-mode door: `packages/objectql/src/record-currency-guards.test.ts -t "raw aggregate over a record-mode amount"` gives `Tests 4 passed | 70 skipped (74)`.
- `dispatch-gates --commands`: 68 derived families, run with each exit code captured before any pipe. `--ran` reconciliation: `68 derived, 67 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, exit 3, `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` (it reads every package's `dist`, and only the mcp closure was built). CI runs it.
- `node scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs`: OK.
- `overlap-check.mjs`: `VERDICT clean exit 0`, against origin/main `7d8dcf693a` and 0 open PR heads.

</details>

The families CI runs (`Lint & Repo Gates`, `Test Core`, `Build Core`, the type-check lanes) are left to this PR's check-runs.
